title: Keep the candidate changelog in sync with merged checkpoints
summary: Prepare release notes from the combined reviewed commit, including the current numbered checkpoint range and its exact public CI evidence.
benefits: Gives reviewers a reliable scope and evidence map
risks: A draft summary can become stale as stacked work lands

evidence.claim: Before the v0.0.4 release: The candidate document still names the first fifteen checkpoints.
The reconciled changelog covers v0.0.3.1 through v0.0.3.30, and the published release links the exact-commit run and release receipt.

decision.reason: Included in the owner-approved publication of Lydite v0.0.4. https://github.com/vixttha/Lydite-Test-Vault-Template/releases/tag/v0.0.4
